title: The verdict of journalist Ahmad Fauzi
paragraphs: The verdict of defamation against Central Javanist journalists has now been read, the defendant is sentenced to trial.

According to the charges, Ahmad Fauzi published a story about a wild pick-up at the port on November 17, 2025, which the prosecutor judged to accuse someone of doing something to ruin the good name of someone.
The Court of Justice of Semarang reads the verdict on March 30th, 2026, a complete copy of the verdict has not been published yet.
In the matter of Ahmad Fauzi, the legal power of Zit Wicaksono says this matter has already gone on for two years and requests that the justice be completed at a reasonable time.
Ahmad Fauzi worked as a Central Javanese journalist now in Semarang, a journalist's organization assessing that this case could have a lesson in press freedom.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal, Ahmad Fauzi is not under arrest.
